# One goal row

What a goal says wherever goals are listed: the same slots in the same order, each list choosing only what fills the reason, the second line and the button.

## The rule

Every list of goals (Home, Watching, Goals' list and trees, a goal's contributing goals, the check-in queue, a review's agenda) draws one row. `rowParts(goal, attention, place, facts)` gives its parts; the row only lays them out. It writes no sentence of its own: each part is a shared rule's words (the flags, `nowText`, `gapBeside`, `statusChange`, `goalResult`, the vocabulary), so the screens and the AI assistant's `find_goals` (its `reason` and `context`) say the same reason for the same goal.

### The slots, in this order

| Slot | Holds | Always there |
|---|---|---|
| Status | The status's shape and word. | Yes |
| Value | The number now (`nowText`), and under it how it stands against the plan (`gapBeside`), or, for a goal gone quiet or (with no set rhythm) a status not from this week, "as of week {n}"; a finished goal's result in the vocabulary's words. | Yes |
| Name | The title, a link to the goal's page; its tell (its key, else its team) when another goal has the same title (see Names in [numbers and names](numbers-and-names.md)); its level where the workspace shows levels. | Yes |
| Reason | One sentence: why it is in this list, by the place's rule below. A flag that isn't the status says its word first ("Getting worse: …") and takes the warning mark; the Off track, At risk and No recent update flags are the status, so their detail has no mark. | When the place has a rule |
| Context | A second line, only when it changes what the reader does: an open ask the goal waits on, when the reason isn't already that ask ("Waiting on {name}: {ask}.", or "Waiting on you: …" for the person asked), with the warning mark; or "Draft kept" in the check-in queue. | Only then |
| Action | One button, only in a task list: "Check in", "Carry on" (a draft is kept) or "Correct it" (this week's check-in is posted). | Only in task lists |

A row with no action is one link, edge to edge. A row with an action links only its name, because a button inside a link is invalid.

### What fills the reason, by place

The flags are taken worst first by the shared weight (see [flags](flags.md)); the `due` flag is never a reason except on Home. One reason, never a list or a count of flags.

| Place (`place`) | Reason | Context | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Home, your goals (`home-mine`) | The top flag; else the `due` flag's words; else how fresh it is ("Checked in 2 days ago.") | An open ask | "Check in" while one is due |
| Watching, needs attention (`watching-needs`) | The top flag | An open ask | None |
| Being handled (`watching-handled`) | What puts it in hand (`handledFor`'s line), then " · " and what was said | None | None |
| Watching's other goals, and Home's goals you watch (`watching-rest`, `home-watching`) | The top flag; else "Was {status} in week {n}." and how fresh it is, when its status changed at its latest check-in; else the owner and how fresh it is | None | None |
| Goals, and a goal's contributing goals (`goals-list`) | The top flag; else the owner (left out in a list of your own goals) and how fresh it is | None | None |
| The check-in queue (`checkin-queue`) | What the latest check-in before this week said that the value doesn't: "Last week: {the owner's reason}" (or "Week {n}: …"); nothing when there was no reason. Once posted this week, "Checked in {day}." | "Draft kept" | "Check in", "Carry on" or "Correct it" |
| A review's agenda (`agenda`) | What is in hand (`handledFor`'s line), else the top flag | None | None |

### Layout

At 700 px and wider a list's rows share four columns, so values line up down a list: status (140 px, never truncated), the name with the reason and context under it, the value (168 px, right-aligned, tabular figures), and the action. Narrower, the status and value share the first line (the value wraps under the status word as one unit) with the action at its right, never smaller than 44 × 44 px; the name has its own full-width line; the reason takes two lines at most. Colour belongs to the status shape and word, the gap's words and the off-track wash over the whole row; the warning mark takes the at-risk ink; nothing else is coloured. Long names wrap; they never truncate.

The row is core, with no switch: every list uses it. The places that belong to a module (Watching, a review's agenda) go with their module.

## Worked examples

Each is run against the real rule by `src/spec/spec.test.ts`: the result is what the code gives.

| Given | The rule gives |
|---|---|
| Cost: requests right-sized (cost-requests), on track, the trend heading short of its target: the row in Watching’s Needs attention. | `On track \| 73% · 1 pt behind plan \| ⚠ Getting worse: On track today, but the recent trend heads for 78–79% by week 53, against a target of 80%. \| — \| —` |
| Halt on failed contract tests (cfr-halt), a milestone off track: the row in Goals. | `Off track \| 2 of 3 stages · Late · Not met \| Observability reprioritised, and our dependency moved to their next sprint. \| — \| —` |
| CI time (lead-ci-time), off track, waiting on Amara’s decision: the row in Watching, as Amara sees it. | `Off track \| 8 min · 3 min behind plan \| Blocked on Infrastructure & Compute: we need their change before we can switch the runner pools on. \| ⚠ Waiting on you: approve the extra CI runner budget for Q4. \| —` |
| The same goal in Rhea’s check-in queue, with a draft kept. | `Off track \| 8 min · 3 min behind plan \| Last week: Half of the runner pools is done; the rest waits on Infrastructure & Compute’s release, now planned for next month. \| Draft kept \| Carry on` |

## Where it lives

- [src/domain/goalRow.ts](../../../src/domain/goalRow.ts): `rowParts`, `flagReason`, `freshnessOf`

## Requirements

- `GOAL-ROW`: One goal row in every list of goals (Home, Watching, Goals, the check-in queue, a review's agenda): the status's shape and word first, then the number and its gap, then the name (with its tell when another goal has the same title), then one reason in the words of that list's rule (a flag that isn't the status takes the warning mark), an optional second line for an open ask or a kept draft, and one button only where the list is something to do. On a phone the status and value share the first line and the name has its own full-width line. The row is core: every list uses it, so it has no switch.

## Tests that check it

### [src/domain/goalRow.test.ts](../../../src/domain/goalRow.test.ts)

- the goal row: one set of slots in every list › on track with a forecast miss: status On track, and the reason is "Getting worse: On track today, but…" with the warning mark
- the goal row: one set of slots in every list › stale with a last known value: the last number and "as of week 40", and no warning mark, because the flag is the status
- the goal row: one set of slots in every list › off track with an open ask: the owner’s why is the reason, and the ask is the context line, "Waiting on you" for the person asked
- the goal row: one set of slots in every list › a milestone: its stages as the value, and how late beside them
- the goal row: one set of slots in every list › done: the result in words, from the vocabulary
- the goal row: one set of slots in every list › no check-in yet: "No value yet", and Home has the Check in button while one is due
- the goal row: one set of slots in every list › one reason, never a list of flags: the top flag by the shared weight, and no count of the rest
- the goal row: one set of slots in every list › only task lists have an action: the check-in queue says Check in, Carry on with a draft kept, and Correct it once posted
- the goal row: one set of slots in every list › the check-in queue’s reason is what last week’s check-in said that the value doesn’t: the owner’s reason, not the number again
- the goal row: one set of slots in every list › a list with nothing flagged names the owner and how fresh the goal is; a list of your own leaves the owner out
